name: Extinction-based Shading and Illumination
definition: A shading technique that computes ambient occlusion, soft shadows, and color bleeding by aggregating extinction coefficients using a 3D Summed Area Table (SAT) instead of traditional shadow ray sampling.
summary: Extinction-based Shading and Illumination is a GPU-accelerated technique that computes global illumination effects like ambient occlusion and color bleeding by aggregating extinction coefficients via a 3D Summed Area Table.
